independent_reference.source: (1) Hand-derivation in tools/testkit/golden/derivations/d3q19.md §§ 1-5: Gauss-Hermite quadrature on the D3Q19 sub-lattice gives weights {1/3, 1/18, 1/36}, sound speed c_s² = 1/3, and the second-order equilibrium f_i^eq = w_i ρ (1 + c·u/c_s² + (c·u)²/(2 c_s⁴) - u²/(2 c_s²)). (2) Qian, Y. H., d'Humières, D. & Lallemand, P. (1992), 'Lattice BGK Models for Navier-Stokes Equation', Europhysics Letters 17 (6), 479-484, DOI 10.1209/0295-5075/17/6/001, § 2 eq. (3a) plus Table 1 — original D3Q19 specification with weights and equilibrium identical. (3) Krüger et al. (2017), 'The Lattice Boltzmann Method: Principles and Practice', Springer, ISBN 978-3-319-44649-3, Ch. 3 Table 3.4 / Appendix A.2 — textbook reproduction with identical numerical values. (4) Python re-derivation by tools/testkit/golden/generator/d3q19_equilibrium.py.
